description: This source file defines extensions on the `FileHandle` class to provide safe, throwing API wrappers for reading data until EOF or up to a specified byte count, with error handling that returns empty `Data` on failure.

classes.name: FileHandle
classes.description: Extension providing safer read methods to avoid exceptions during EOF or handle errors gracefully.

methods.name: readToEndSafely()
methods.description: Reads data until EOF using `try self.readToEnd()`, returns empty Data on failure.

methods.name: readSafely(upToCount: Int)
methods.description: Reads up to a specified byte count using `try self.read(upToCount:)`, returns empty Data on failure.
